[SWS_UCM_00264] Update verification rejected
⌈
If any call of the State
Management UpdateRequest Service Interface VerifyUpdate returns error kRe-
jected too many times (maxNumberOfVerifyUpdateRetries) or for too long (
verifyUpdateTimeout), UCM shall transition to kRollingBack state.
⌋

[SWS_UCM_00264] Update verification rejected
⌈
If any call of the State
Management UpdateRequest Service Interface VerifyUpdate returns error kRe-
jected too many times (maximumNumberOfRetries) or for too long (retryInter-
valTime with role prepareUpdate), UCM shall transition to kRollingBack state.
⌋

[SWS_UCM_00264] Update verification rejected
⌈
If any call of the State Management UpdateRequest Service Interface Veri-
fyUpdate returns error kRejected too many times (maximumNumberOfRetries)
or for too long (retryIntervalTime with role prepareUpdate), UCM shall transition
to kRollingBack state and report FAILED to the UCM_UPDATE_VERIFICATION_-
REJECTED production error. When the update verification accepted, a PASSED shall
be reported alternatively.
⌋

[SWS_UCM_00264] Update verification rejected
⌈
If any call of the State Management UpdateRequest Service Interface Veri-
fyUpdate returns error kRejected too many times (UcmRetryStrategy.Max-
imumNumberOfRetries) or for too long (UcmRetryStrategy.RetryInterval-
Time with role prepareUpdate), UCM shall transition to kRollingBack state and re-
port FAILED to the UCM_UPDATE_VERIFICATION_REJECTED production error. When
the update verification accepted, a PASSED shall be reported alternatively.
⌋
